milestone: M1 — gaode-maps harness ban (six matcher surfaces) + per-agent DO-NOT prompt block

qa.user_verbatim_complaint: 系统性彻底禁止除了 timeline 和 transport 以外的 subagent 使用任何高德地图 skill。使用 harness 原则，并且在 prompt 中也禁止。

out_of_scope_observations.observation: The 30-case CASES matrix exercises 5 surfaces directly: skill, bash-token, network-host, env-var, read-path. The 6th surface bash-resolved-path is NOT directly exercised by any CASES row — verification relies on bash-token catching the literal 'gaode-maps/' substring in the same commands. The bash-resolved-path matcher logic was independently spot-checked by QA via direct policy_registry call with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=/root/travel-planner and confirmed working (matched '/.claude/skills/gaode-maps/' on a python3 invocation of the gaode poi script). Recommend extending verify script with an explicit bash-resolved-path case (e.g. invocation via `bash wrapper.sh` style where the literal command lacks gaode tokens but the resolved script lives under the gaode tree) for future-proofing. Non-blocking: in production every command attempting to invoke the gaode python scripts contains `gaode-maps/` literally and is caught by bash-token; the bash-resolved-path matcher is defense-in-depth only.

Dev added two extras beyond BA spec: (a) `AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY` to gaode_denied_env_vars (covers the BA-flagged fetch-images-batch.py risk), (b) `*.amap.com` glob to gaode_denied_network_hosts (defense-in-depth). Both are scope-additive (catch more, deny no legitimate use) and align with spec §5.13C clause 2. Noted as positive observations.

spec_section_updates.section_4:
**Cycle 1 — measured state after dev implementation**

- `verify-gaode-ban.sh` harness: 30/30 cases PASS (alias normalization + skill/bash-token/network-host/env-var/read-path matchers × 5 role inputs + 5 negative non-gaode-target cases). Exit code 0. Output captured by QA.
- End-to-end hook spot-check (AC1): payload `{tool_name:Skill, tool_input:{skill:'scripts:gaode-maps:tools:routing'}, agent_id:meals-test-agent}` piped to `python3 /root/.claude/hooks/pretool-tool-policy.py` → exit 2 with stderr JSON `{role:null, tool:Skill, surface:skill, matched_pattern:scripts:gaode-maps, deny_reason:gaode-policy: identity-default-deny on surface skill (matched scripts:gaode-maps)}`. (Note: agent_id resolves to None because `meals-test-agent` is not registered; identity-default-deny correctly fires.)
- End-to-end hook spot-check (AC2): payload `{tool_name:Bash, tool_input:{command:'python3 /root/travel-planner/.claude/commands/scripts/gaode-maps/scripts/poi_search.py keyword X 110000'}, agent_id:meals-test-agent}` → exit 2 with stderr JSON containing `surface:bash-token, matched_pattern:gaode-maps/`.
- AC2 alternate path (`bash-resolved-path`): direct call `is_gaode_allowed('meals', 'bash-resolved-path', 'python3 /root/travel-planner/.claude/commands/scripts/gaode-maps/scripts/poi_search.py')` with `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=/root/travel-planner` set → returned `False` with reason `gaode-policy: role meals not in allowlist {timeline, transportation} on surface bash-resolved-path (matched /.claude/skills/gaode-maps/)`. Production hook sets CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR via harness wiring; matcher confirmed working.
- AC7: Grep `## DO NOT (harness-enforced)` over `.claude/agents/` returned 7/7 banned project agents (meals, attractions, accommodation, cafe, entertainment, shopping, budget) with exactly 1 match each; `timeline.md` and `transportation.md` returned 0 matches (allowlist preserved).
- AC8 backward-compat: `is_gaode_allowed('meals', 'read-path', '/root/travel-planner/data/foo/meals.json')` → `True` with reason `not-a-gaode-target`; `is_gaode_allowed('meals', 'skill', 'scripts:rednote:tools:search')` → `True`. Non-gaode tool calls unaffected.
- Policy file integrity: `tool-policy.v1.json` `policy_version: 2`; all 8 required `gaode_*` keys present (allowlist canonical agent IDs, allowlist aliases, denied skill prefixes, denied bash tokens, denied bash resolved path prefixes, denied network hosts including `*.amap.com` glob, denied env vars including extra `AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY`, denied read path prefixes, fail-closed-on-unknown-agent=true).
- Code-quality: zero hardcoded gaode tokens (`amap.com`, `AMAP_KEY`, `gaode-maps`) in either `pretool-tool-policy.py` or `policy_registry.py` — all values are policy-data-driven (Grep returned 0 matches).
- Files modified: 12 (per dev-report); files created: 1 (`scripts/verify-gaode-ban.sh`). `policy_registry.py` grew 280 → 480 lines (under 800-line cap). 7 banned project agents had `gaode-maps` removed from frontmatter `skills`, imperative bash invocation blocks removed/rewritten to rednote-only, and DO-NOT block prepended. `timeline.md` and `transportation.md` unchanged (verified).
- Hook layer integrity confirmed: the QA agent itself is being blocked by the harness in real time when attempting bash commands containing `gaode-maps/` substrings — a self-validating end-to-end demonstration that the hook is wired and active.

qa.complaint_resolution_evidence: User's verbatim complaint asks for systematic ban of gaode-maps for non-{timeline,transport} subagents at both harness AND prompt layers. M1 delivers exactly this: harness layer = 8 new policy keys + 6 surface matchers wired through pretool-tool-policy.py with identity-default-deny on missing agent_id + fail-CLOSED on gaode (asymmetric to global LOW-10 fail-open); prompt layer = 7 banned project agents each receive an identical `## DO NOT (harness-enforced)` block plus removal of every imperative gaode invocation line, while timeline.md and transportation.md remain unchanged (allowlist preserved). 30/30 verification cases PASS; AC1-AC8 spot-checks PASS.

root_cause_verification.rationale: BA root cause: pre-existing tool-policy.v1.json had zero of the 8 required gaode_* keys; pre-existing hook had no gaode classifier; 7 banned agents had positive gaode instructions and no DO-NOT block. Dev addressed all three: (1) added 8 new keys to policy with policy_version bump 1→2; (2) added 13 functions to policy_registry.py + 7 functions to pretool-tool-policy.py forming a 6-surface dispatch table called BEFORE the standard tool/path check (per BA OBJ-5 to capture raw command string); (3) prepended identical DO-NOT block to 7 banned project agents and removed all imperative gaode invocation lines while preserving schema enum values. Identity-default-deny on missing agent_id correctly bound asymmetric to gaode-only via _gaode_identity_pre_check called BEFORE role-None early-exit. Alias normalization (`transport`→`transportation`) bound BEFORE allowlist check via normalize_gaode_agent_id. All 30 verify-gaode-ban.sh cases PASS; AC1-AC8 spot-checks PASS.
